input_end: Start offset of genuinely next source unit, only if the nonempty interval after the preceding unit is entirely whitespace
reason: Whitespace or newline actually observed after the terminal/closer run proves that run is closed. A terminal at prefix EOF alone is insufficient, since a future closer/terminal could extend it.
prefix_check: segment(exact_source_text[:cutoff]) spans must equal the complete source's first target_index spans; no target character read by prediction
targets: Original next unit index4..min(31,source_unit_count-1), same source; no reindexing, bridging or replacement
no_whitespace_anchor: Keep selected record and original candidate pair in coverage; mark boundary_unconfirmed for this prefix task
additional_local_scan: One already-acquired annual-file pass for boundary-only eligibility verification after independent review, zero inference and no sample replacement
preregistration_limit: This defines a whitespace-boundary-supported subset; it is not an online model at arbitrary character or sentence endings
